name: run_checks
description: Run one of the project's own checks (what its CI, README or Makefile run: `cargo test`, `pnpm test`, `just ci`) in your worktree, in the workspace's environment; returns the exit code and the tail of the output. Only exit code 0 passes. A failed run uses up one of your limited check cycles and is reported as a check: never use it to look around (run_command) or to change files (run). The same failed check on unchanged code is answered from the earlier run (no cycle). A command the shell cannot find means a missing tool: reported, no cycle, the person decides.

command.description: Shell command, run with `bash -lc` (`sh -lc` without bash) in the worktree, in the workspace's environment

cwd.description: Optional sub-directory of the worktree to run in (relative, inside the worktree)

repo.description: The slot to run in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed; at most the deployment's limit, which is also the default. Example: {"command":"npm test","timeout":120}
